$comment: Component: contracts. Owning Team: Transaction Integrity Office (TIO). Classification: INTERNAL. Related Docs: CLAUDE.md 3 and 4.2, ADR-0013, contracts/events/topics.psv. Hash rule: ADR-0013.
title: aaas.ledger.appended.v1
description: Published by ledger after an addition is appended to the immutable ledger. Carries the whole ledger entry, so that cloud-notary can verify the hash chain without access to the ledger database. Consumed by stopwatch (stop of the official time) and billing (invoice).

producer.description: The only service allowed to publish this event (contracts/events/topics.psv).

taskId.description: Addition task the event belongs to; never null for this event.

payload.description: The ledger entry: position in the chain, operands, result, recording time and the hash chain link.

sequence.description: Position of the entry in the hash chain: 1 for the first entry, then increasing by one without gaps.

a.description: First operand of the recorded addition.

b.description: Second operand of the recorded addition.

recordedAt.description: Instant the entry was appended; part of the hashed content, so it is fixed in the millisecond UTC form.

prevHash.description: Hash of the previous entry; 64 zeros for the first entry (sequence 1).

hash.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string `prevHash|taskId|a|b|result|recordedAt`: the fields joined by `|`, numbers in decimal without leading zeros, taskId and recordedAt exactly as in the event (ADR-0013).
